findings.title: Unchanged edit cannot be saved when the task's upstream is archived
findings.where: §12.1 dependsOnTaskId row; §14.2 Depends on; §9.3; §10.3 edge cases; Home.tsx:1216 options exclude archived
findings.fix: Validate dependsOnTaskId only when draft.dependsOnTaskId !== existing.dependsOnTaskId (exists, !archived, !self, !wouldCycle); an unchanged link is always valid. Render the current archived upstream as an extra option labelled '{title} (Archived)'. Unit test: archive 9, save 10 unchanged keeps dependsOnTaskId 9. Add to AC-21.3 that changing to an archived task is refused.

findings.title: canHandOver references a non-existent permission and its pure signature cannot see it
findings.where: §12 F17(g); §13.1/§13.2 state/handover.ts; §3.5 More menu; §14.1 Hand over rows
findings.fix: Define canHandOver(task, ctx: { canEditOrReassign: boolean }) = !task.archived && task.status !== 'done' && (isCurrentUser(task.assignee) || ctx.canEditOrReassign); the store passes accessMatrix['Department Head']['Edit or reassign tasks'] (current user is Department Head, §18). handoverTaskPure returns null for missing, done, archived, !canHandOver or invalid draft and takes the same ctx. Test: with the toggle off, the item shows only on tasks 1, 4, 7, 9; AC: absent on archived and done tasks.

findings.title: ChainSetu is linear but dependency groups can branch; rendering rule missing
findings.where: §10.3 Rendering; §3.5 TaskCard dependency lines; IA-11; AC-21.2
findings.fix: Dashboard group: path = upstreamPath(deepest waiting task; ties by title asc); the ordered list names every waiting task; when waiting has tasks off the path, caption '+{k} more waiting on other branches' (also in aria-label). Card 'wait on this one' line: text only, no ChainSetu; ChainSetu sm only with the 'Waiting on' line using upstreamPath(task). Add a dependencies.test.ts case with two dependents of task 9.
